events.verdict: Kessler (UTA) moves alongside Brown's (BOS) path and maintains a legal guarding position as he contests the driving shot attempt.
White (BOS) moves alongside Sexton's (UTA) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the drive to the basket.
Kornet (BOS) wraps his arm around Kessler's (UTA) back and initiates contact that affects his post shot attempt.
Sensabaugh (UTA) initiates body contact with White (BOS) that affects his SQBR.
White (BOS) releases away from Sensabaugh (UTA) to receive the pass.
Brown (BOS) establishes himself in a position in Kessler's (UTA) path, but Kessler moves around him and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Boston signals for a timeout prior to any illegal contact by Sensabaugh (UTA) and the timeout is granted.
Collins (UTA) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Brown's (BOS) arm as he reaches for the pass.
Collins (UTA) commits a take foul on Brown (BOS).
Holiday (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Collins (UTA). Any contact with Collins' arm after the contact to the ball is considered incidental.
